summary: Tested Regime-Assistant / Research-Mode feature (06/2026) end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 unit tests pass (test_evidence_robust_0626 + test_regime_hierarchy_assistant_0626). New API regression file with 9 tests all pass: overview (4 classes, crypto 1d x 8h, indices 1w x 1d, forex 1d x 4h, fallback_enabled false, research_mode robust/time), run auth (401/403), invalid class 400, job 404, job lifecycle running->done, 409 on concurrent run (verified when candles not cached), runs/latest with summary.light + variants combined/primary/macro, live/BTCUSDT combined fields, research-mode roundtrip incl. invalid values ignored + restore, config fallback roundtrip persisted in overview. Frontend: admin login -> tools menu -> Regime-Lab shows regime-assistant section with all required data-testids; tab switching updates recipe text correctly; research-mode select shows toast 'Bewertung gespeichert' and persists after reload; fallback toggle persists after reload; all settings restored to defaults (robust/time/fallback off). No page errors / crash. Dynamic-strategy settings (macro_filter_enabled, transition_guard_min_conf) NOT tested via API: no dynamic_strategies in local DB (code reviewed only; clamp 0..95 present in routers/dynamic.py). UI run button NOT clicked (it runs full class: 8 symbols x 720 days without symbol/days params -> would take very long); run flow verified via API instead.

minor.issue: Non-numeric days (e.g. {"days":"abc"}) -> 500 Internal Server Error (int() ValueError uncaught in routers/regime_assistant.py line 48). Should return 400 or ignore.

When candles are cached a job finishes in ~150ms, so the 409 guard only protects slow runs; repeated clicks create many duplicate runs in DB (I produced 12 duplicates during testing, cleaned up). Consider a short cooldown/dedup.
KEEP_RUNS=20 pruning is global across all asset classes (find({}) .skip(20)), so 20 crypto runs would delete the only indices/forex/resources run. Prune per asset_class.
_latest is in-memory only and never reconciled; overview class-tab light can differ from /runs/latest if runs are removed (cosmetic).

Macro variant score is null ('zu wenig Daten') for both BTC and ETH with 300 days: macro 1d regime is ~100% sideways (BTC: 1 phase) yet few_phases=False for 1 phase. Summary therefore reports 'Makro –' and combined size_factor 0.5. Expected with short history, but few_phases flag looks inconsistent; recipe default 720 days is fine.
First uncached call takes ~60s (candle download) - frontend/consumers should tolerate; no timeout guard.

integration_issues.issue: Button posts only {asset_class} -> full recipe (all 8 crypto symbols x 720 days, 1080 days for indices) with no days/symbol choice or ETA; can run 10-20+ minutes. Not a bug but consider showing estimated duration / allowing a quick mode.

issues: Summary line 'Ampel: grün (gut)' wraps into 3 lines in a narrow column; layout is cramped but readable
Esc does not close Regime-Lab modal (pre-existing, minor)

action_items: Validate 'days' in POST /api/regime-assistant/run (return 400 instead of 500 for non-numeric)
Prune regime_assistant_runs per asset_class instead of globally
Optional: review few_phases flag when a variant has only 1 phase; consider dedup/cooldown for repeated runs
critical_code_review_comments: services/regime_assistant.py run(): global KEEP_RUNS pruning can delete other classes' latest run
JOBS/_latest are process-local in-memory state; fine for --workers 1, breaks if scaled to multiple workers (409 guard and job polling would fail across workers)
routers use raw Dict bodies instead of Pydantic models (consistent with existing code, but no input validation)

success_rate.backend: 100% (42/42 tests; 1 minor 500 on invalid input found by manual probe)

seed_data_creation: Test runs created via API were deleted by id (12 runs); the original crypto run df10a7214643 (BTC+ETH) remains as latest. Research mode and fallback config restored to robust/time/false. New test module has autouse teardown deleting only its own run ids.
